$comment: Single source of truth for tinystyle's vocabulary. Generates llms.txt and html-custom-data.json (npm run gen) and drives tinystyle check. A test keeps it in sync with src/*.css. Context rules for tinystyle check: tags (the elements it works on; tagsFor overrides per value; notTags: elements it breaks), with (attributes it needs on the same element; null = any value), parent (what its parent must match), inside (an ancestor it needs), loose (parent/inside are warnings, and only for plain parents without class or style).

data-variant.description: Button style. Leave it out for the default solid main button (black in light mode, white in dark mode). Combine with data-tone for color.

values.secondary: Tinted fill, no border. Second most important action.
values.ghost: Transparent, fill on hover. Toolbars, icon buttons, Cancel.
values.link: Looks like a link, keeps button semantics.
values.item: Full-width, multi-line list entry (message list, search results). Selected (aria-current, aria-selected or aria-pressed) gets a soft accent background. data-size="sm" makes a compact row (event chips).

data-variant.short: Button style; leave it out for the solid main button.

data-tone.description: Color role. Independent of data-variant. On text it sets the text color. For a custom color use style="--ts-tone: <color>" instead.

values.neutral: Grey. Default for secondary/outline/ghost buttons and badges.

data-tone.short: Color, independent of the style; for any other color use style="--ts-tone: …".

data-size.description: Control size relative to the current density.

data-icon.on: button, a, or any element (span) for a standalone icon
data-icon.description: An icon by name (Lucide names). is an icon; puts it before the text; an empty is a square icon-only button and needs an aria-label. Without a value () it makes a square icon button around your own svg. The default set needs icons.css (or all.css); the Vite plugin makes every Lucide icon and your own SVG folder available.
data-icon.short: Icon by Lucide name; an empty button with it is a square icon-only button (needs aria-label).

data-layout.description: Lays out the element's children. Wins over the element's own display, so it also works on label, article, fieldset, dialog. Space between children comes from data-gap, space around them from data-pad; children never get margins.

values.row: Horizontal row, items vertically centered. Wraps onto more lines when it runs out of space, except on button, a and label (icon + text stays on one line). Override with data-wrap.
values.grid: Responsive columns, each at least --ts-min wide (default 16rem). A few items keep their column width instead of stretching across the row.
values.split: Sidebar + content. First child is the sidebar (--ts-split, default 16rem); wraps on narrow screens.
values.center: Horizontally centered column with side padding. Its content is at most --ts-measure wide (default 72rem); the padding comes on top.

data-layout.short: Lays out the element's children (overrides its own display).

data-cols.description: Exactly this many equal columns instead of responsive ones (week and month grids, a 7-day picker). Columns never wrap; use data-show to swap in another layout on phones.
data-cols.short: Exactly this many equal grid columns.

data-gap.description: Space between the children of a data-layout element. Default md. Together with data-pad, the only spacing controls in tinystyle.

data-pad.on: any container: page wrappers, sections, panels, rows
data-pad.description: Padding inside the element, on all sides. Use it instead of padding in style attributes. On data-layout="center" the side padding never drops below md. Overrides a component's own padding (e.g. data-pad="sm" on an article).

data-self.on: a child of data-layout (stack, row, grid)
data-self.description: Aligns this one child across the layout, overriding data-align. Typical: an "Add" button in a stack that should not stretch to full width (data-self="start").
data-self.short: Aligns this one child (e.g. data-self="start" keeps a button in a stack from stretching).

data-wrap.description: Whether a row wraps onto more lines. Rows wrap by default.

values.none: Keep everything on one line (nav items, icon + label).

data-grow.on: a child of data-layout=row or stack
data-grow.description: This child takes the remaining space in its row or stack (and may shrink below its content in a column, e.g. a scrolling pane). Typical: the search field in a toolbar (<input type="search" data-grow>), the input in an input + button row, the title that pushes actions to the right. It starts at --ts-grow-basis (default 8rem): with less room the row wraps and it gets its own line.
data-grow.short: This child takes the remaining space in its row or stack.

data-scroll.on: a wrapper around wide or tall content (table, code, list pane)
data-scroll.description: Scroll container. Without a value it scrolls sideways when the content is wider than the screen, instead of making the whole page scroll (wrap wide tables in it). data-scroll="y" scrolls vertically inside a fixed-height area (panes in a data-shell="fixed" app, message lists).
data-scroll.short: Scroll container: sideways by default, "y" vertical (panes), "both".

data-density.description: Control height and padding for everything inside.

values.compact: 2rem controls, smaller text. For dense apps.

data-theme.description: Forces light or dark mode. Leave it out to follow the operating system.

data-badge.description: Small status label (counts, tags, states). Color with data-tone or style="--ts-tone: …".

data-callout.description: Tinted message box. Put the title in <strong>. Color with data-tone (default info).

data-truncate.description: Single line, cut off with an ellipsis.

data-clamp.description: Cuts text off after this many lines with an ellipsis (data-truncate is the one-line version).

data-bar.on: any element, usually a data-variant="item" row or a card
data-bar.description: A colored bar on the start edge in the element's tone. Event chips: <button data-variant="item" data-size="sm" data-bar style="--ts-tone: #4CAF50">.

data-sr-only.description: Hidden visually, still read by screen readers.

data-pairs.description: Shows dt/dd pairs as a two-column label/value grid.

data-caption.description: Small, semibold, muted label text: captions above values, group headings like a letter in an index.
data-caption.short: Small, muted label text (captions, group headings).

data-list.on: ul, ol or any container of rows
data-list.description: One bordered box whose children are rows separated by lines: settings lists, keys, devices. Each child gets padding (data-pad on a child overrides it); give a child data-layout="row" data-justify="between" for label + action rows. Card styling of article children is removed, so <article role="listitem"> rows need no extra attributes. A leading <template> child does not count as the first row.
data-list.short: One bordered box; its children are rows separated by lines.

data-divider.description:
A horizontal line with the element's text in the middle, e.g.

or

between two sign-in options. Empty, it is a plain line.

data-avatar.description: Round avatar with initials, or an child that fills it. Colored by tone (default accent); size with data-size or style="--ts-avatar-size: 4rem".

data-stretch.on: the main link or button inside an article
data-stretch.description: Makes the whole card clickable through this element. Other links and buttons in the card stay clickable. Use it on the card's title link, or on a data-variant="link" button.

data-shell.on: body or the outermost app wrapper
data-shell.description: App shell: a navigation rail ([data-rail]) next to <main>. On narrow screens (< 48rem) the rail becomes a drawer. Without a value the document scrolls; with data-shell="fixed" the shell fills the viewport and <main> scrolls inside it, for multi-pane apps (give inner panes data-scroll="y").
data-shell.short: App shell (rail + main); data-shell="fixed" fills the viewport and main scrolls inside.

values.fixed: Fills the viewport; main scrolls inside it.

data-rail.description: Navigation rail. It must be a direct child of [data-shell]. Children: optional <header> (brand, collapse toggle), links/buttons or a <ul> of them, optional <footer> pinned to the bottom. Items need no attributes; mark the active one with aria-current="page" (CSS cannot detect the current page). Put item text in a <span> so it can hide when collapsed. Add the popover attribute and an id to get a drawer on narrow screens (< 48rem), opened by <button popovertarget="…" data-show="narrow">; without popover the rail stays visible on narrow screens.
data-rail.short: Navigation rail next to <main>; with popover it is a drawer on narrow screens.

data-collapsed.description: Icon-only rail, set in the markup (e.g. rendered by the server from a saved preference). For a toggle the user can click, use a data-rail-collapse checkbox instead.

data-rail-collapse.on: input type="checkbox" inside [data-rail] (usually in its header)
data-rail-collapse.description: Collapse toggle drawn as a chevron icon button. Checked = icon-only rail. Needs an aria-label. CSS cannot remember it across page loads: render checked from a saved preference, or save it with a few lines of script.

data-rail-label.description: Hidden while the rail is collapsed (e.g. the user name in the rail footer).

data-fab.description: Floating action button fixed in the bottom-right corner. Combine with data-icon and an aria-label.

data-show.description: Shows the element only on narrow (< 48rem) or wide screens.

values.narrow: Only below 48rem (e.g. the button that opens the drawer).

data-menu.description: Menu of buttons, links and checkbox labels; <hr> separates groups. On a [popover] opened via popovertarget it is placed under its button (a plain [popover] without data-menu is centered in the viewport).
data-menu.short: Menu of buttons, links and checkbox labels; as a [popover] it opens under its button.

data-combo.on: a wrapper around an input and its suggestion list
data-combo.description: Combobox: the data-menu (role="listbox", options role="option", the highlighted one aria-selected="true") inside it opens under the field. Show and hide the list from script.
data-combo.short: Wraps a field and its suggestion list (data-menu, role="listbox"), which opens under it.

data-toasts.on: one div per page, at the end of <body> (role="status"; popover="manual" to show above modal dialogs)
data-toasts.description: Toast region: fixed to the bottom corner (bottom center on phones), stacks its [data-toast] children with the newest at the bottom. Give it role="status" so screen readers announce new toasts. Optionally popover="manual": it then sits in the top layer above an open modal dialog (call showPopover() on it again after opening a dialog).
data-toasts.short: Toast region (one per page, role="status"); holds data-toast children.

data-toast.description: A toast: a short message with optional actions (data-variant="link" or "ghost" buttons, data-size="sm") and a close button (data-icon="x" with aria-label). data-tone adds a colored bar. Your code appends it to [data-toasts] (it slides in) and removes it after a few seconds; set hidden first to fade it out. Use role="alert" on the toast for errors.
data-toast.short: A toast inside data-toasts; data-tone colors its bar.

data-tooltip.on: buttons, links and any focusable element
data-tooltip.description: Tooltip shown on hover (after a short delay) and keyboard focus. data-tooltip="text" shows the text; data-tooltip without a value shows the element’s aria-label, so an icon button keeps one label (aria-label="Delete" data-tooltip). The text in data-tooltip="…" is visual only; screen readers do not get it, so do not put anything there that is not also in the label or visible. In a data-rail it opens to the side and only shows while the rail is collapsed. Not for buttons that open a menu (their caret uses the same space).
data-tooltip.short: Tooltip: the given text, or the aria-label when empty.

data-num.on: th and td of a number column
data-num.description: A number cell: right-aligned with tabular figures, so digits line up. Put it on the header cell and every cell of the column (and the footer total). In a sortable header the sort arrow moves to the left.
data-num.short: Number cell: right-aligned, tabular figures (on th and every td of the column).

--ts-hue.description: Accent hue in OKLCH degrees. Default 255.

--ts-neutral-hue.description: Hue the greys lean toward. Default: --ts-hue.

--ts-neutral-tint.description: How much the greys lean toward --ts-neutral-hue. Default 0 (pure grey).

--ts-primary.description: Tone of default buttons. Default var(--ts-neutral); var(--ts-accent) for colored main buttons.

--ts-radius.description: Base corner radius. Default 0.375rem. The other radii derive from it.

--ts-badge-radius.description: Badge corner radius. Default 0.67 × --ts-radius; var(--ts-radius-full) for pills.

--ts-font-sans.description: UI font stack. Default: system fonts.

--ts-min.description: Minimum column width for data-layout="grid". Default 16rem.

--ts-fill.description: Subtle fill: code, hover, neutral secondary buttons.

--ts-accent.description: Accent: selection, focus, links, checked controls.

--ts-neutral.description: Neutral tone (near-black in light mode, near-white in dark mode).

--ts-tone.description: Current tone. Set it to any color to recolor an element and its children (e.g. calendar colors).

--ts-tone-on.description: Text color on a solid --ts-tone fill (black or white).

--ts-shadow-sm.description: Resting shadow (none in the default look).

--ts-control-h.description: Height of buttons and inputs, set by data-density.

--ts-control-px.description: Horizontal padding of controls, set by data-density.

--ts-control-font.description: Font size of controls, set by data-density.

--ts-rail-width-collapsed.description: Width of a collapsed rail. Default: one icon button plus padding.

--ts-grow-basis.description: Width a data-grow child needs before its row wraps. Default 8rem.

--ts-icon-<name>.description: The icon image for data-icon="<name>", as a url() of an SVG (shape only; the color is the text color). Set it to replace a default icon or to add your own: :root { --ts-icon-rocket: url(/icons/rocket.svg); } plus [data-icon="rocket"] { --_icon: var(--ts-icon-rocket); }.

deprecated.$comment: Renamed names, old → new. They keep working (the CSS keeps a selector for them, the types accept them) until the next major version; tinystyle check warns (TS112) and --fix rewrites them. Not listed in the docs.
